Menopause-related skin changes can show up as a thinner, looser or more crepey-looking appearance across the arms, neck, chest, stomach, thighs and hands.

A basic body lotion adds moisture.

But moisture alone isn’t the whole answer to the appearance of crepey, thinning skin.

That’s why NØRD BODY uses Copper peptides, caffeine and CoQ10.

Use 1–2 pumps once daily on clean, dry skin. Massage it in for 5–10 minutes as part of a simple daily body ritual.

The fast-absorbing formula leaves skin with a silk-dry, non-greasy finish.

Skin looks softer in approximately 4 weeks, with visible firming around 6–8 weeks.
